rationale: Positive: The agent verified identity correctly using full name + zip, matched to a single user, and fetched the latest order ID from tools. No order-changing actions were taken, so no confirmation was needed. Negative: The agent stated the total amount paid ($829.43) and the specific payment method used (Mastercard ending 1065) without explicit support from the tool outputs shown. The order details provided did not display a total, taxes, shipping, discounts, or the payment method; the agent appears to have assumed the total equals the sum of item prices and inferred the payment method from stored methods. This risks being incorrect (e.g., taxes in WA, shipping, or different payment source) and violates the policy against inventing unsupported facts. Therefore, despite correct authentication, the final information is not sufficiently supported by the tools.
